title: One-sided negative sectional curvature and the holomorphic Liouville property
summary: We construct, in some sufficiently large fixed finite complex dimension m , a domain in ℂ m diffeomorphic to $`\mathbb R^{2m}`$ that admits a complete Kähler metric with real sectional curvature at most −1 and has only constant bounded holomorphic functions. Its sectional curvatures are unbounded below. The construction gives a negative answer to the one-sided bounded-holomorphic-function question.
family_title: Negative Kähler curvature without bounded holomorphic coordinates

review.reason: Constructs a complete Kähler metric with negative curvature bound and no nonconstant bounded holomorphic functions.
